color.$description: Named by role, not by hue. Components and agents use only these.

text.$description: All text: headings, body, labels, links. The only text colour (decision 20).

text-muted.$description: Secondary text: captions, meta, hints. 4.85:1 or better on every light background.

text-emphasis.$description: Gold italic words in headings (decision 18). Allowed only in h1 and h2. Never in smaller headings (h3 and below), card titles or body text: at 3.5–3.8:1 on the beige backgrounds (4.3:1 on white) it passes AA only as large text. Project themes change it.

text-emphasis-on-dark.$description: Italic words in headings on color-surface-dark. 6.1:1.

surface-subtle.$description: Alternate sections, e.g. the contact section.

border.$description: Decorative dividers only. 1.3:1, too faint for anything a user must see: use color-border-input for inputs.

border-input.$description: Resting input underlines. 3.36:1 on background, 3.78 on surface, 3.10 on surface-subtle (WCAG 1.4.11 needs 3:1).

error.$description: The only error colour: field errors, invalid underlines, error messages. 5.88:1 on background, 6.61 on surface, 5.42 on surface-subtle.

success.$description: The only success colour. 6.27:1 on background, 7.06 on surface, 5.79 on surface-subtle.

accent.$description: Brand gold fill: accent button background, secondary-link underline. Not a text colour on light backgrounds.

theme.$description: Project theme colour in case studies: eyebrow rules, links, metric numbers. Project themes change it (decision 16).

theme-muted.$description: Theme-tinted decorative border, e.g. the pull-quote rule.
